Creating with Purpose

Driving Growth Through Innovation and Excellence

[vc_column_text el_class=”paragraph”]

At Dhinimex, we approach every project with purpose—combining technical expertise, reliable service, and a deep commitment to Cambodia’s development. Our work is grounded in innovation and executed with precision and care. The following vision, mission, and core values define the principles that guide us as we expand our impact locally and globally.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column css_animation=”fadeIn” width=”1/2″ el_class=”col-create_purpose”][vc_single_image alignment=”center” image=”126″ css=”.vc_custom_1754965832355{margin-bottom: 25px !important;}”]

Vision

[vc_column_text el_class=”paragraph text-justify”]

Innovating Locally, Impacting Globally

Our vision is to become a leading corporation in electrical appliances, water supply, and technological innovation, delivering world-class solutions and service that drive sustainable growth and industry impact, both locally and internationally.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column css_animation=”fadeIn” width=”1/2″ el_class=”col-create_purpose”][vc_single_image alignment=”center” image=”125″ css=”.vc_custom_1754965404171{margin-bottom: 25px !important;}”]

Mission

[vc_column_text el_class=”paragraph text-justify”]

Lorem line title

Our mission is to drive leadership in the electrical and technology sectors by delivering high-quality products and expert services, creating job opportunities, and expanding access to modern energy and clean water–especially in rural Cambodia. Through innovation, ethical practices, and professionalism, we aim to enhance our supply capabilities, empower communities, and establish a strong presence in the global market.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column css_animation=”fadeIn” el_class=”col-create_purpose core-value”][vc_single_image alignment=”center” image=”127″ css=”.vc_custom_1754965855926{margin-bottom: 25px !important;}”]

Core Values

Quality Assurance

[vc_column_text el_class=”paragraph des-item-coreVal”]We are committed to delivering only high-quality products that meet or exceed Cambodian and international standards such as TIS, IEC, ANSI/IEEE, or specific client requirements.[/vc_column_text]

Technical Excellence

[vc_column_text el_class=”paragraph des-item-coreVal”]Our equipment is built with premium materials, efficient design, and engineered to pass all routine and type tests for performance, safety, and longevity.[/vc_column_text]

Customer Commitment

[vc_column_text el_class=”paragraph des-item-coreVal”]We prioritize customer satisfaction by providing only products that meet rigorous internal quality controls, ensuring reliability and value in every solution delivered.[/vc_column_text]

Standards-Driven Innovation

[vc_column_text el_class=”paragraph des-item-coreVal”]We design and manufacture with a dual focus on local and global standards, merging innovation with compliance to deliver dependable, future-ready solutions.[/vc_column_text]

Integrity and Professionalism

[vc_column_text el_class=”paragraph des-item-coreVal”]We adhere to ethical practices and professional conduct in every aspect of our operations—from product development to customer service and global partnerships.[/vc_column_text]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column offset=”vc_hidden-xs”]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][/vc_section][vc_section][vc_row][vc_column]

Our Leadership

Meet Our Chairwoman

[vc_column_text el_class=”paragraph”]

Guided by our chairwoman’s vision and leader, Dhinimex has established itself as a trusted and respected corporation within the industry.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row gap=”35″ content_placement=”middle”][vc_column width=”1/3″][vc_single_image image=”981″ css=”.vc_custom_1761622035076{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}”][/vc_column][vc_column width=”2/3″]

Vong Sorphorn

Chairwoman of the Board of Directors

[vc_column_text el_class=”paragraph text-justify”]Dhinimex Group originated from a small-scale business founded in 2003 and has since grown into a well-recognized company known for its continuous development and meaningful contributions to both society and the nation.

The company’s strength and longevity are rooted in its firm commitment to a core direction: to earn recognition and trust from customers by upholding strong ethical standards, transparency, and integrity. Dhinimex places high importance on excellent service and product quality, which are key factors behind its current success and sustained growth.

This progress has been made possible thanks to the dedicated efforts of a collaborative team that works like a family, with persistence, strong commitment, mutual support, and effective communication. The principle of unity as strength has been central to the company’s advancement.

Today, Dhinimex continues to grow and actively promotes the development of its workforce through training and encouragement of innovative thinking. The company aspires to remain a leading choice at the national level while advancing its mission on the international stage.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column offset=”vc_hidden-sm vc_hidden-xs”]

[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width=”1/3″]

Directors

Management Team

[vc_column_text el_class=”paragraph text-justify”]Dhinimex’s management team brings together a diverse group of experienced professionals with deep expertise in engineering, finance, operations, and strategic development. Through collaborative decision-making, proactive leadership, and a strong commitment to accountability, the team drives the company’s continued success across multiple sectors. Their hands-on approach, combined with a focus on operational excellence and innovation, ensures that Dhinimex remains adaptable, resilient, and competitive in an evolving market.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/3″ el_class=”col-director”][vc_single_image alignment=”center” css_animation=”boc_animate_when_almost_visible boc_zoom” image=”984″]

Sutharsan Chelladurai

Managing Director

[vc_column_text el_class=”paragraph”]

“Leadership is about taking responsibility, leading with honesty, respecting people, inspiring with vision, and delivering results that shape a better future.”

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/3″ el_class=”col-director”][vc_single_image alignment=”center” css_animation=”boc_animate_when_almost_visible boc_zoom” image=”987″]

Gheknai Kong

Deputy Managing Director and Chief of Finance

[vc_column_text el_class=”paragraph”]

“Passion and Discipline make you a better person.”

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column offset=”vc_hidden-xs”]

[/vc_column][/vc_row][/vc_section]
